title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds, guided by core values: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are changing the world for the better through innovation in financial services.

The opportunity is to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and enjoys helping end users in need of assistance. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing cloud-first infrastructure and networks, and you will work with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams.

Responsibilities

  • Be the first line of customer-facing IT support for employees via Slack, Jira, and other tools; own the support experience.
  • Proficient in troubleshooting on macOS and enterprise deployment; procure and deliver technology equipment; manage onboarding and offboarding of employees.
  • Design, test, build, document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge base.
  • Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management tools (MDM, EMM, Jamf).
  • Own and improve identity providers and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta) and integrate systems via APIs.
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate recurring tasks; handle critical incidents to resolution.
  • Prioritize help desk tickets effectively and work on projects over sprints with Jira; align objectives to team and company goals.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR, and other teams; communicate clearly and learn quickly in a supportive environment.
  • Supervise IT operations to ensure security-first, scalable, cloud-first infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open-source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and workflows in Okta; API experience and cross-system integration; remote support across multiple countries/time zones.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; clear writing in tickets, email, and Slack; ability to explain complex concepts simply.
  • Strong troubleshooting knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching) and OSI model layers; ability to self-manage and scope projects across teams.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, adaptability in a high-growth environment, and a builder mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Nice to have: experience with AWS, GAM, command-line interfaces for efficiency, Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications, remote work experience.

Benefits and Culture

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting from day one; competitive PTO; equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A role with purpose and opportunity for growth within Ledn, a global digital asset company.
  • Committed to inclusivity, diversity, and equal opportunity employment; confidentiality in accommodation requests during recruitment.
  • Remote-first environment with a global team; selects processes may include a short video response as part of the selection process; no agencies or recruiters please; Ledn does not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

About Ledn

Ledn’s team is global, spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe, and operates as a remote-first company. We believe digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s products and services play a critical role in making that possible.

EEO and Contact

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process, you may reach out by emailing the designated team contact. All requests will be addressed confidentially.

Additional notes

We reserve the right to contact only qualified applicants due to high volume. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to them.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Overview

Position: Operations Manager — Full-Time Employee (Brazil). Work from anywhere and help us keep the company engine running smoothly!

About the Company

The company is a fast-growing pet health brand committed to helping dogs live longer, healthier, and happier lives. We create science-backed, vet-approved products — all manufactured in the USA — and deliver them directly to customers worldwide. We're lean, scrappy, and entrepreneurial, and we’re building a team that thrives in that kind of environment.

Scope of the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, resourceful Operations Manager to lead the day-to-day business operations and ensure everything runs like clockwork. This role isn’t about managing factories or supply chains — our products are USA-made finished goods and shipped through 3PL partners. Instead, it’s about taking initiative, solving problems, creating systems, and ensuring operational excellence without needing constant oversight.

Ideal candidates are based in Brazil or LATAM, fluent in English, and comfortable working EST/CST hours. You should have experience in DTC e-commerce, ideally in human or pet supplements, and be a natural at creating order and momentum within a growing startup.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Act as the main point of contact for manufacturers, 3PL fulfillment partners, and logistics providers.
  • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate timely reorders with suppliers.
  • Troubleshoot vendor and fulfillment issues, escalating when needed and ensuring resolution.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage internal workflows (order tracking, inventory reporting, vendor communication).
  • Monitor and improve KPIs like inventory health, fulfillment speed, returns, and customer experience.
  • Develop and maintain SOPs to create consistent, scalable operational processes.

Decision-Making & Initiative

  • Proactively identify and address operational gaps or inefficiencies.
  • Anticipate risks (e.g., stockouts, shipping delays, bottlenecks) and implement solutions.
  • Share data-backed insights and operational recommendations with leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing and Customer Support to ensure product availability aligns with active promotions.
  • Partner with Finance to manage vendor invoices, track costs, and maintain budget alignment.
  • Support executive leadership with special projects and scaling initiatives.

Requirements

Years of Experience

  • 3+ years in operations, vendor management, or business coordination (e-commerce or consumer goods preferred).

Background

  • Experience working in fast-paced DTC brands — ideally with supplements (human or animal).
  • Proven track record of independently managing logistics, vendors, or internal ops workflows.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce business operations and customer experience touchpoints.

Tools and Software

  • Proficient in Google Sheets / Excel for tracking and reporting.
  • Experience using project management tools like Asana, Trello, or ClickUp.
  • Comfortable using Slack and remote communication tools.

What We’re Looking For

  • A self-starter who takes initiative and doesn’t wait for instructions.
  • Someone who spots inefficiencies and brings solutions to the table.
  • A process-driven operator who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment.
  • High-accountability team player who cares deeply about delivering results.

Why Join the Company?

  • Join a team of passionate, pet-loving people on a mission to make a difference.
  • Work remotely with flexibility, ownership, and trust.
  • Play a key role in scaling a high-growth DTC brand.
  • Grow your career as we expand our product lines and markets.

Remote-first part-time freelance Brand Designer role at tl;dv. Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to a full-time role within 12 months based on impact. Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design. Compensation set based on agreed hours/work scope of part-time role (flexible).

We are building a differentiated brand in a competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech/SaaS/AI and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

To learn more about the brand and culture, check out tl;dv Culture & Careers page and our Product Hunt launch. Direct access to founders and a fast-moving environment await.

We are looking for highly motivated team players to join our hungry squad.

Portions of text referencing people or media in this section have been preserved for context but will be presented in a clean format below.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 hours for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of hands-on design experience in SaaS/AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know the category patterns and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste with refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; ready with references.
  • Bold yet coachable; able to defend strong creative while remaining collaborative.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with; low-ego team player with crisp communication.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress/Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus: light motion skills (After Effects or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Ability to produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understanding of performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat within 12 months based on results.
  • Ship work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, and outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SAas and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

  • Email: ******
  • Important: Share your LinkedIn and portfolio.

If you’re serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters. The more your application stands out, the faster we’ll respond.

To learn more about our culture and how we work as a team, check out our Culture & Careers Page.

We really can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing, the first line of support; own support, and provide an outstanding support experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.
  • Troubleshoot, use the terminal, and make macOS work in the enterprise.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding experience for all new employees and the retrieval process for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets with project work; work in sprints and document progress in Jira (adhere to agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proven ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS (no certifications required).
  • Experience with GAM and CLI work to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership aligned with startup/tech environment values.

Our culture and expectations

  • Have a passion for progress; adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Builder’s mindset; eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially with confidential information.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company; equity through shared ownership.
  • Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (restrictions apply).
  • A career with purpose; we remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer; inclusive and diverse, with success from diversity.

Application and Environment

  • You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.
  • Ledn is a globally distributed, remote-first team spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
  • As part of the selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.
  • No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Information Technology

Industries

  • Retail

Nosso time no Brasil possui aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Respeitamos e apoiamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, vetando adiscriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião, ou quaisquer características protegidas por lei. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Se você tem como valores, integridade, espírito empreendedor e inovação, o seu lugar é aqui! Venha fazer parte do nosso time!.

  • Um ambiente de desafios com muitas oportunidades de mudanças e transformações.

  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos processos de controle e reportes financeiros, contribuindo para a otimização de custos e resultados.

  • Mão na massa! Gosta de resolver problemas e abrir caminhos para grandes ideias;

Processo seletivo

Boa sorte!

A Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore é uma joint venture entre a Wilson Sons e a Ultramar. A Wilson Sons é um dos maiores operadores integrados de serviços marítimos, portuários e de logística do Brasil, com mais 180 anos de experiência. A Ultramar é um grupo chileno com mais de 60 anos de experiência, presença em 15 países e grande experiência em serviços de agenciamento marítimo, apoio portuário, logística e transporte.

Com 23 embarcações, a Wilson Sons Offshore oferece apoio marítimo a plataformas de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás. No trajeto entre as plataformas e os terminais portuários, as embarcações PSV transportam equipamentos, lama de perfuração, tubos, cimento e alimentos, entre outros materiais necessários ao negócio dos clientes da indústria de petróleo e gás, e trazem ao continente os dejetos acumulados nas plataformas. Além disso, a empresa também opera com embarcações LSV.

Trata-se do segmento mais jovem da Wilson Sons: suas atividades foram iniciadas em 2003. Hoje já contamos com uma das maiores e mais modernas frotas em apoio Offshore com bandeira brasileira.

O compromisso da Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore é continuar investindo para apoiar o crescimento de seus clientes e do Brasil. A meta deste ano frente a este cenário desafiador é a redução dos custos e o aumento de produtividade.

Importante: todas as vagas da Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore também estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência.

O processo de recrutamento e seleção na WSUT está em conformidade com as exigências da Lei 13.709/2018 Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados, e trata de maneira segura e objetiva os dados pessoais dos candidatos às nossas vagas. As informações enviadas pelos candidatos, por ocasião de sua inscrição em processos seletivos ou envio de currículos para composição de base de talentos, são tratadas única e exclusivamente para o enquadramento em oportunidades de trabalho, busca e contato com o candidato. A WSUT não compartilha nenhum dado pessoal com demais áreas internas da empresa e tampouco para empresas terceiras. Todos os dados são descartados de forma segura ao final de cada processo de seleção ou quando mantidos em banco de talentos o mesmo se dá pelo período máximo de 365 dias, estando facultado aos titulares dos dados o acesso, atualização e pedido de exclusão.

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Realizar atendimento clínico e cirúrgico em Ortopedia nas áreas: CER, enfermarias, centro cirúrgico, unidade de terapia intensiva e ambulatório do Hospital.

  • Avaliação 3

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Medical Writer / Senior Scientific Communications Specialist (French)

Position Summary

The Senior Scientific Communications Specialist is a professional with scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise, responsible for oversight of staff and client services. The position also provides scientifically accurate and balanced information to internal stakeholders, external healthcare professionals, and consumers in a way that supports business needs; is aligned with regulatory and compliance practices; and is consistent with Medical Affairs and brand team objectives.

Essential Functions

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential Functions

  • Develop and review content for scientific documents including standard and custom responses, slide decks, dossiers, manuscripts, slide decks, and other deliverables requested by the client.
  • Demonstrate ongoing scientific expertise relevant to therapeutic areas, including products, disease state management, and emerging therapies.
  • Integrate scientific expertise with knowledge of regulatory and compliance guidelines to ensure comprehensive review of materials submitted into the approval process.
  • Create and/or review medical affairs materials and promotional materials.
  • Apply approved standards of style to created and maintained materials.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in the use of content management systems as applicable.
  • Update Standard Response format and content for integration into a global content management system.
  • Respond to Medical Information Requests (via calls/web/emails/letters) and conduct appropriate scientific information exchanges with the requestors.
  • Participate in scientific training as appropriate to support assigned brands.
  • Comply with all guidelines, policies, legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements.
  • Meet or exceed service levels and targets for internal and external customers.
  • Participate in training and mentoring of new hires or staff changing support areas.

The Senior Scientific Communications Specialist may also be responsible for the following:

  • Serve as a team lead for 1 or more Clients, therapeutic areas, workstreams, or brands.
  • Coordinate with Client to schedule meetings and training sessions, and ensure that all team members meet all training requirements.
  • Manage and distribute overall workload for a brand or therapeutic area.
  • Coordinate, lead, and participate in workstreams, special projects, pilots, or other activities requested by the client.
  • Serve as key contact for communications between the Client and Med Communications team.
  • Maintain active role in Quality Assurance processes, including monitoring of performance indicators.
  • Provide medical information support via multiple venues including virtual presentations and medical meeting booth coverage.

Qualifications

  • Above average attention to detail, teamwork and initiative.
  • Ability to interact with other departments within the company and be proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and quickly able to learn new software.

  • Applied Learning - Engages in learning activities to maximize outcomes.

Education, Languages, Experience

  • Computer Skills: Proficiency with Embase, Ovid, and content management systems preferred.

title: Partner Account Manager - Public Sector
description:
Overview

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This role will join Samsara’s Global Partnerships team, which is responsible for building and activating our ecosystem of go-to-market partners across Insurance, co-sell, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Public Sector routes to market, and Fleet Management Companies.

You’ll be responsible for our Public Sector referral partners and tier 2 reseller partners - building scalable programs to drive business via Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner motions, sharing Samsara’s innovation with our partners, and helping to drive a differentiated presence in the market.

This is a great role for somebody looking to make an impact and influence the future of our Public Sector partnership strategy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

description:
Sobre nós

O Magalu é uma das maiores empresas de varejo do Brasil, reconhecida por sua inovação e presença digital. Com mais de 60 anos de história, conecta milhões de clientes por meio das lojas e de uma plataforma multicanal, oferecendo produtos e serviços de qualidade. A empresa investe continuamente em transformação digital, tecnologia e diversidade, criando um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

Nós representamos uma macro-área de Data Analytics. Nosso time é dividido por pessoas com perfis variados de dados (Analistas de Dados, Engenheiros de Dados, Cientistas, Business Analytics, etc) e também por pessoas com perfil atuante em Pricing, Finanças, Produto e Planejamento Estratégico. Nossa função é navegar por todas as BU's da vertical (grand chef, plus delivery, aiqfome) e conseguir entregar recomendações de negócios baseadas no que os dados estão nos dizendo, para isso, você estará diariamente em contato com times de Marketing, Vendas, Produto, e Tecnologia.

  • Somos uma área que tem por objetivo evangelizar a cultura de dados e experimentação;
  • Faremos estudos de eficiência, apontaremos caminhos e compartilharemos aprendizados;
  • Somos um time aficcionado pelo nosso usuário: seja ele o fominha, seller, CM, indústria ou fomer;
  • Criaremos uma plataforma de dados robusta, com automatização, dashboards e modelos de AI;
  • Se você precisa fazer a mesma coisa todo dia/semana, você precisa automatiza-la.

Descrição do Cargo

Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Liderança na Estratégia e Coleta de Dados: Liderar a identificação, avaliação e extração de dados de fontes complexas e variadas (bancos de dados, APIs, data lakes), definindo as melhores práticas e garantindo a integridade e relevância dos dados para as análises estratégicas.
  • Modelagem e Governança de Dados: Desenvolver e implementar processos robustos de limpeza, transformação e modelagem de dados, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e governança das informações em toda a empresa.
  • Análise Preditiva e Diagnóstica: Conduzir análises complexas, incluindo modelagem estatística, testes de hipóteses e análises preditivas, para diagnosticar tendências, identificar oportunidades de crescimento e prever cenários futuros.
  • Desenvolvimento e Liderança de Dashboards Estratégicos: Projetar, desenvolver e gerenciar dashboards e relatórios estratégicos para a alta gestão, focando em KPIs que direcionem o desempenho do negócio e facilitem a tomada de decisão em tempo real.
  • Parceria Estratégica com Áreas de Negócio: Atuar como um parceiro estratégico para as lideranças, compreendendo profundamente suas necessidades e traduzindo desafios de negócio em projetos de dados que gerem valor e impacto mensurável.
  • Otimização e Arquitetura de Consultas: Elaborar e otimizar consultas SQL complexas em grandes volumes de dados.
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura e performance dos bancos de dados analíticos.
  • Automação e Escalabilidade de Processos: Liderar a automação de pipelines de dados e processos analíticos, utilizando ferramentas de ETL/ELT para aumentar a eficiência, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das nossas operações de dados.
  • Comunicação e Influência: Comunicar insights e recomendações de forma clara e persuasiva para audiências diversas, incluindo executivos e stakeholders não técnicos, influenciando a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  • Mentoria e Desenvolvimento da Equipe: Atuar como mentor para analistas de dados júnior e pleno, compartilhando conhecimento, promovendo as melhores práticas e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento técnico e analítico da equipe.
  • Inovação e Pesquisa: Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias, metodologias e abordagens em análise de dados e machine learning, mantendo a empresa na vanguarda das práticas do mercado.
  • Precisamos Que Você Tenha
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou mestrado em áreas relacionadas a dados será considerado um diferencial.
  • Proficiência em SQL (MySQL e Google BigQuery): Experiência avançada na criação e otimização de consultas complexas.
  • Conhecimento em Window Functions, CTEs (Common Table Expressions) e boas práticas para performance e controle de custos em ambientes de nuvem.
  • Expertise em Ferramentas de BI (Power BI e Looker Studio): Domínio completo de pelo menos uma das ferramentas (preferencialmente ambas) para criar dashboards complexos, interativos e de alto impacto.
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados (DAX no Power BI) e integração de múltiplas fontes de dados.
  • Programação em Python para Análise de Dados: Proficiência em Python e suas principais bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experiência na automação de processos, manipulação de grandes volumes de dados e integração com APIs.
  • Conhecimento Estatístico Aplicado: Sólida compreensão de conceitos estatísticos e sua aplicação prática em negócios (testes A/B, análise de regressão, testes de hipóteses) para validar resultados e gerar insights mais profundos.
  • Google Workspace (Planilhas e Apresentações): Habilidade para ir além do uso básico, utilizando Google Sheets para análises rápidas e prototipagem, e Google Slides para comunicar resultados complexos de forma clara e persuasiva para a liderança.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de solucionar problemas técnicos complexos com autonomia.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborativo com times multidisciplinares.

O que buscamos: um profissional com visão estratégica de segurança para colaborar com times de software, infraestrutura e operações, contribuindo com a melhoria contínua da postura de segurança da organização.

Responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de segurança: projetar e garantir a implementação de arquiteturas de segurança robustas e escaláveis para aplicações e infraestrutura em ambientes Multi Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), alinhadas com as melhores práticas de mercado e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Apoiar no design seguro de sistemas: trabalhar com Arquitetos de Software e equipes de desenvolvimento para integrar segurança desde as etapas iniciais do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (Secure SDLC), realizando análises de ameaças (Threat Modeling) e revisões de design.
  • Garantir a segurança em ambientes Cloud e Contêineres: implementar e otimizar controles de segurança para plataformas Cloud (principalmente GCP, incluindo GKE, Cloud SQL), redes (VPCs, firewalls, micro-segmentação) e ambientes conteinerizados (Kubernetes), assegurando conformidade e proteção de dados.
  • Promover a cultura DevSecOps: colaborar para a integração de práticas de segurança nas esteiras de CI/CD (SAST, DAST, SCA, image scanning), automatizando verificações e garantindo deployments seguros por design.
  • Gerenciar Identidade e Acesso: projetar e implementar soluções de IAM, autenticação forte (MFA, SSO) e gestão de segredos para assegurar o princípio do menor privilégio.
  • Assegurar conformidade e auditoria: atuar para que as soluções estejam em conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentações externas (ex: LGPD, Bacen para clientes do setor financeiro), preparando ambientes para auditorias de segurança.
  • Documentar e disseminar conhecimento: criar e manter documentação técnica de segurança, padrões e guidelines, e atuar como referência para o time em decisões técnicas de segurança.
  • Visão estratégica e melhoria contínua: contribuir com a visão estratégica de segurança, identificar tendências e novas ameaças, propondo melhorias para a postura de segurança dos ambientes.

Qualificações / Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em Arquitetura de Segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento profundo em plataformas Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), com foco em serviços de segurança nativos (ex: Security Command Center, Security Hub, GuardDuty, WAF).
  • Domínio de Kubernetes Security (RBAC, Network Policies, image scanning, runtime security).
  • Experiência com DevSecOps e integração de segurança no pipeline de desenvolvimento.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e padrões de segurança (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Top 10, Zero Trust).
  • Conhecimento em IAM, gestão de segredos, criptografia e proteção de dados.
  • Habilidade para Threat Modeling e análise de riscos.
  • Boa comunicação e proatividade para interagir com equipes multidisciplinares e stakeholders.

Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Note: The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

Responsibilities

  • You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS and related environments.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces for efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We\'re looking for a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company.
  • The option to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
  • We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our team is globally distributed and remote-first. Due to high volume of applications, only those who qualify will be contacted. Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. Ledn is committed to building a stake for employees in the future of the company and the digital economy.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The role is customer-facing, and you will be the first line of support for employees, via tools such as Slack and Jira.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Manager of IT who will wear multiple hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. The right candidate has demonstrated success in similar roles within rapidly growing, security-first environments and is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of Ledn\'s growing cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner looking for a supportive environment to grow IT skills. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing IT support to employees (via Slack, Jira, etc.); manage Mac-based enterprise environments.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding and offboarding experience for employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document IT programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and respond to issues through to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects in sprints (Jira, agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tooling (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows; strong API skills for system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; hardware shipping and customs experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching), and OSI model steps.
  • Self-management skills to scope projects and coordinate across multiple teams; strong organizational skills.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace).
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment with a values-driven approach; remote work experience.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package, starting on day one; comprehensive benefits and PTO.
  • Equity ownership in the company; opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven role in a global digital asset company; inclusive, diverse culture; accommodation support during recruitment.

Additional Information

  • Ledn operates as a remote-first company with a global team across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume applications, only qualified candidates will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; public social media review may be conducted. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

Employment Details

  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Retail

Nice to haves

  • Basic proficiency in Spanish or a desire to learn
  • Experience or interest in using AI or automation tools to scale outreach
  • A good sense of humor

Why join Clara

At Clara, you\'ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

  • We\'re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.
  • Certified as one of the world\'s fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup.
  • Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.
  • Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.
  • Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.
  • Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

  • #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.
  • #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.
  • #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.
  • #Pride. We build products and experiences we\'re proud of.
  • #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.
  • #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one
  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)
  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths
  • High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together
  • Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact
  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you\'re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara\'s Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don\'t enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you\'re expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

description:
Tech manager infosec seguranca da informacao

Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Gestão de Equipes de InfoSec: Liderar, motivar e desenvolver o time de segurança, garantindo excelência técnica e evolução de carreira;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Conformidade: Mapear riscos, acompanhar auditorias e manter os controles de segurança atualizados, mitigando vulnerabilidades em sistemas, processos e fornecedores;
  • Estratégia de Segurança: Definir e implementar a visão de InfoSec, alinhando práticas de segurança da informação aos objetivos de negócio e compliance (ISO 27001 e LGPD);
  • Resiliência Operacional: Estabelecer planos de resposta a incidentes, post mortems de falhas e priorização de soluções de longo prazo;
  • Arquitetura Segura: Apoiar times de engenharia e produto na definição de soluções resilientes e seguras, garantindo boas práticas em identidade, criptografia, monitoramento e resposta a incidentes;
  • Governança e Políticas: Estruturar e revisar normas, políticas e procedimentos de InfoSec, assegurando sua aplicação em toda a companhia;
  • Integração com o Negócio: Atuar junto a stakeholders internos e externos (clientes, parceiros e auditores) para demonstrar a maturidade do programa de segurança.

Requisitos

  • Experiência como Tech Manager, Security Lead ou correlata em empresas de tecnologia SaaS;
  • Conhecimento em ISO 27001, LGPD, gestão de riscos, auditorias e SoA;
  • Vivência com gestão de equipes técnicas, incluindo contratação, feedbacks, desenvolvimento e desligamentos;
  • Proficiência técnica em arquitetura de segurança de sistemas web e cloud (identidade, IAM, criptografia, monitoramento, incident response);
  • Experiência em traduzir requisitos regulatórios e de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Familiaridade com gestão de fornecedores de segurança e acompanhamento de contratos/SLAs.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Certificações de mercado: CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 LA/LI;
  • Experiência prática com DevSecOps e integração de segurança em pipelines de desenvolvimento;
  • Atuação prévia em empresas SaaS da área fiscal/financeira;
  • Experiência em FinOps aplicado à segurança, com otimização de custos de ferramentas e licenças;

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 adiantados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive! Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Company and Hiring Notes

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. About Darkroom Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has driven billions of dollars in trackable revenue across ecommerce, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs. We accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. This role is fully remote within EST business hours and open to candidates in Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

About The Role We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’ll dive into pixels, provide tactical feedback on design and video, and connect performance frameworks with creative testing and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but focused on paid media. You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role blends creativity with data-informed decision making and reports to the Director of Creative, leading Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance through a high volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative, including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video, with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon).
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with ownership of performance results.
  • Experience collaborating with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Strong English communication skills and ability to present creative work clearly and professionally to internal teams and clients.
  • Ability to give constructive feedback to other designers and mentor their growth.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous campaign goals into visually engaging, conversion-focused concepts.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, asset handoff) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) for asset creation.
  • Bonus: experience designing high-performing ads for ecommerce, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We hire A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership and support each other relentlessly. We value autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philadelphia, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this transition.
  • Opportunities for growth through cross-functional collaboration and skill development.

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere.

Field Reimbursement Specialists (FRSs) are responsible for providing field support for patient access to client’s specified products through interaction with the client’s patient support program and provider customers.

FRSs provide their expertise and advanced skills to resolve complex patient access and provider reimbursement issues and to provide educational services across a variety of healthcare provider sites of care.

FRSs work directly with the provider and their office support staff and commonly interact with other reimbursement and patient support services provided by clients.

Play a vital role in helping patients gain access to life-changing therapies! From oral medications to biosimilars to critical cancer treatments, our associates, with their passion for patients, represent these therapies providing education, coverage, and access solutions to healthcare personnel.

FRSs will plan and engage with customers, leveraging client-approved resources, to educate on access and reimbursement topics relevant to assigned client’s product.

Our teams travel weekly, which could include overnight, to healthcare offices within a designated territory, using their knowledge of coverage, patient assistance, and health policy to educate office staff and break through access issues to ultimately help patients.

Typical Day:

  • Educate provider office staff and practice managers on logistics needed to support client product, including infrastructure needed to support in-office administration.
  • Educate provider office staff with understanding the payers’ coverage management strategies for product, including coding, billing, formulary, prior authorization, and appeal processes.
  • Probe to understand office processes and ability to discern root causes of access or reimbursement issues.
  • Deliver interactive educational presentations at various provider sites of service.
  • Provide information on relevant reimbursement topics related to our client’s products based on client’s approval.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to conduct field-based reimbursement and access support, education, and consultation to key account customers and cross-functional partners.
  • Understands the dynamics of Specialty Pharmacy vs. Specialty Distribution.
  • Broad understanding of the physician buy-and-bill model vs. assignment of benefits to alternate sites of care.
  • Experience in revenue cycle, buy and bill, formulary, benefit investigations, prior authorization, coding, and appeals processes.
  • Deep understanding of medical and pharmacy benefits/policies.
  • Live within a reasonable commuting distance of a major airport in the listed location and be able to travel within a territory that includes but may not be limited to MN, WI, IL.

Education and Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.
  • Bachelor's degree or specific Practice Management experience preferred.
  • Project management skills.
  • Experience with extensive travel.

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’ll dive into the pixels and provide tactical feedback on design and video, while threading together performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but focused on paid media. You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across formats including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

  • Contribuir com relatórios e métricas de qualidade, auxiliando na melhoria contínua dos produtos e processos.

O QUE É NECESSÁRIO PARA A POSIÇÃO?

  • Experiência prática com testes de performance e carga, incluindo definição de cenários e análise de resultados.

  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado para leitura e escrita técnica.

O QUE SERIA UM DIFERENCIAL?

  • Conhecimento em Python, especialmente voltado à automação de testes de rede.
  • Experiência com CI/CD e integração de testes de performance em pipelines automatizados.
  • Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).
